seg.seg_note: Five segments: Test & Measurement, Environmental, Life Sciences & Diagnostics, Dental, Industrial Technologies (+ 'Businesses contributed to Apex joint venture' = equity-method earnings of Apex 69.9, no sales; release labels it 'Equity method earnings of Apex joint venture'; + Other = unallocated corporate). No segment changes in 2012. Segment data from 10-K Note 19 (identical to release). Growth components from 10-K MD&A segment tables, additive presentation (existing businesses = core; acquisitions positive; currency negative = headwind). Total-company growth from release 'Core Revenue Growth' table. Segment D&A only combined (extra.seg_extra). 2012 restructuring charges by segment (MD&A): T&M 22.2, Env 8.0, LS&D 51.5, Dental 9.8, IT 29.1. Core revenue definition now nets out divested product lines that were within acquisition sales.

ngaap.guidance: Updated FY2013 to non-GAAP adjusted diluted net EPS from continuing ops $3.32-$3.47 (from previous GAAP diluted EPS range $3.40-$3.55); Q1-13 adjusted diluted EPS $0.72-$0.77. Reconciliation: GAAP diluted EPS from continuing ops Q1-13 $0.94-$0.99, FY2013 $3.54-$3.69, less anticipated gain on sale of investment in Apex Tool Group (~$220m pre-tax, $(0.19)) and retroactive reinstatement of federal tax provisions in the American Tax Relief Act of 2012 ($(0.03)). Apex divestiture expected to close within two weeks.
ngaap.notes: The Q4-12 release reports GAAP results only for 2012 (no adjusted EPS reconciliation for actual periods); the non-GAAP EPS reconciliation covers 2013 guidance only. Release notes Q4-12 includes a $0.02/share benefit from a mark-to-market gain on a currency swap agreement (not adjusted; the swap's fair value changes are recorded in SG&A per the 10-K). FCF = operating cash flow from continuing operations less purchases of PP&E from continuing operations.

divestitures: Sold for $205m cash; aggregate after-tax gain ASI+KEO $94m ($0.13/sh) in Q1-12 discontinued operations

Acquisition consideration 'approximately $1.8 billion' as published (CF cash paid for acquisitions 1,796.8); Acquired business names from Item 1 / MD&A (Note 2 gives the aggregate only).
